fixtures.env: Boothill E0 solo vs 3 Physical-weak Elite (level 95, 60 Toughness), 3 cycles — Skill 131502 'Sizzlin' Tango' opens the Standoff and grants an Extra Turn (no Energy, 1 SP), the Enhanced Basic 'Fanning the Hammer' wears the 60 Toughness down, breaks the standoff target and procs Talent 131504 'Five Peas in a Pod' extra Break DMG, Ultimate 131503 'Dust Devil's Sunset Rodeo' applies Physical Weakness and delays the target by 40%; the normal Basic 'Skullcrush Spurs' never fires because decide() keeps Boothill in the Standoff or spends his action on Ultimate/Skill

requirements.claim: Skill 131502 'Sizzlin' Tango' is cast 3 times: decide() returns Skill whenever SP >= 1 and Boothill is not already in the Standoff (hunt.ts:1199), perform() spends 1 SP and enters the Standoff (hunt.ts:1223-1226) — 3 casts in 3 cycles.

Every Skill cast grants an Extra Turn (characters.json 131502 notes 'This Skill grants Boothill an Extra Turn'; perform() calls sim.grantExtraTurn(u), hunt.ts:1227) — 3 Skill casts => 3 EXTRA_TURN events.
Ultimate 131503 'Dust Devil's Sunset Rodeo' fires twice: decide() returns ult the moment Energy fills (hunt.ts:1196) — Energy 115 refills twice in 3 cycles.

Exactly 2 scheduled Basic actions in 3 cycles: the only two turns where Boothill acts outside the Extra Turn with Energy below full and no free Skill choice end up as basic (hunt.ts:1198 returns basic while in Standoff) — the other actions are 3 skills (+3 extra turns) and 2 ultimates.

While Standoff is active every Basic resolves as the Enhanced Basic 'Fanning the Hammer' targeting the standoff enemy (hunt.ts:1232-1237): 3 extra-turn basics after each Skill + 2 scheduled basics while the Standoff lasts = 5 hits.
The Ultimate hits its single target once per cast with label 'Dust Devil's Sunset Rodeo' (hunt.ts:1215 sim.hit type ult, Physical, toughDmg 15) — 2 casts => 2 hits.

Solo negative: the normal Basic 131501 'Skullcrush Spurs' never fires — every basic action runs while the Standoff is active (enhanced branch, hunt.ts:1232-1243), and decide() blocks Skill re-cast only into basic (hunt.ts:1198).
Ultimate payment books ENERGY_LOSS reason 'ult_cost' with amount 115 = full Energy pool (energyMax 115, hunt.ts:1173; cost booked before the kit body zeroes energy, hunt.ts:1212).
The Ultimate cast grants the generic castUlt +5 Energy refund after the cost is paid (AGENTS: '+5 Energy (из castUlt)'; observed post-cost ENERGY_GAIN n=5 after both casts).
The Enhanced Basic regenerates 30 Energy (hunt.ts:1238 sim.gainEnergy(u, 30), canon 131502 basic energy); Boothill's first Energy gain of the battle is that extra-turn Fanning at n=30 (57 -> 87).
Each Skill cast spends exactly 1 SP (hunt.ts:1223 sim.spendSp(1), canon 131502 costs 1 SP) — 3 casts => 3 SP_LOSS events, no other SP flow (hunt.ts:1227 ends the perform without gainSp).
Solo negative: the normal Basic SP generation (hunt.ts:1246 sim.gainSp(1)) never runs because no basic reaches the non-Standoff branch (see no_skullcrush_solo), so Boothill never gains SP.
The Standoff enemy takes +30% DMG from the shared pool: skill level-10 param #1 = 0.3 (characters.json 131502 levels 10, hunt.ts:1091-1092 applies vulnAll 0.3 on bh_standoff as a permanent debuff).
Boothill's own stance buff bh_stance ends up at +0.15 mitigation at E0: -0.15 (he takes +15% from the standoff enemy) flattened by the +0.30 Above Snakes non-standoff mitigation (hunt.ts:1093-1097).

Trace A0 Ghost Load converts Break Effect into CRIT: critRate = min(0.30, 0.10 x BE) (hunt.ts:1133-1138); solo Boothill BE = 0.373 from traces (37.3%) => critRate 0.0373, refreshed after every Trickshot gain.
A0 Point Blank: gaining a Pocket Trickshot while in the Standoff grants +10 Energy (hunt.ts:1117-1119); the standoff target breaks twice in 3 cycles => exactly 2 n=10 Energy gains.

The Ultimate delays its target by 40% (characters.json 131503 level-10 param #2 = 0.4; hunt.ts:1216-1217 sim.delay(target, 0.4) with the 'delays ... by 40%' note, hunt.ts:1219) — both casts emit ACTION_DELAY pct 0.4.
Skill resolution order: setStandoff logs 'enters the Standoff' (hunt.ts:1098) first, then perform() grants the Extra Turn (hunt.ts:1227) — the Standoff always precedes the EXTRA_TURN event.

Talent 131504 'Five Peas in a Pod' can only fire on a Weakness-Broken target (canon 131504 'If the target is Weakness Broken'; gate hunt.ts:1145-1146 and the st.broken check hunt.ts:1241), so the first WEAKNESS_BREAK precedes the first 'Five Peas in a Pod (Break)' hit.
onBreak grants the Trickshot before dispelling the Standoff: grantTrick (hunt.ts:1257, logs 'Pocket Trickshot +1') runs before clearStandoff (hunt.ts:1258, logs 'Standoff over').
The Ultimate's Energy cost is booked before the castUlt +5 refund arrives: ENERGY_LOSS reason 'ult_cost' at the cast precedes the n=5 ENERGY_GAIN.

The enhanced basic's Toughness damage (30 base, +50% per Trickshot stack, characters.json 131504 param #4, hunt.ts:1236) plus the Ultimate's 15 toughness break the 60-Toughness standoff target twice in 3 cycles — both WEAKNESS_BREAK events are sourced by Boothill against Elite #1.

Breaking the standoff target grants 1 Pocket Trickshot and dispels the Standoff (canon 131502 'After this target ... becomes Weakness Broken, Boothill gains 1 stack of Pocket Trickshot, then dispels the Standoff'; onBreak hunt.ts:1254-1259) — 2 breaks => 2 'Pocket Trickshot +1' notes (kills never happen, so onKill/onAllyKill stay idle).

Talent 131504 deals extra Break DMG whenever the Enhanced Basic hits a Weakness-Broken target with at least 1 Trickshot stack (hunt.ts:1142-1161, gate hunt.ts:1145-1146, called from hunt.ts:1241): 4 such hit instances in 3 cycles (T2 post-break, T7 post-break, T10, T11 while still broken).

The Standoff is set 3 times and cleared 3 times by every exit route: 2 breaks (onBreak hunt.ts:1254-1259) plus 1 turn-expiry when standoffTurns decrements to 0 at Boothill's turn start (hunt.ts:1186-1193, standing duration 2, hunt.ts:1090) — clearStandoff logs 'Standoff over' (hunt.ts:1101-1109) exactly 3 times.
Each Skill attaches the permanent bh_standoff debuff (vulnAll) to the target (hunt.ts:1092, turns Infinity) — 3 casts => 3 DEBUFF_APPLIED events on the standoff enemy.

The shared SP pool is a stable, RNG-free contract solo: it starts at 3 (ResourceSystem default) and ends at 0 — Boothill's 3 Skill casts each spend 1 SP (skill_sp_cost_3) and he generates none (no_sp_gain_solo), so 3 - 3 = 0. Unlike a live multi-character pool, the solo pool has no regeneration, so the clause is a stable boundary, not a snapshot.
